criteria.reason: Conflict named (religious request vs inclusive programme); tiered options with explicit rationale make the weighing transparent.
Tiered design preserves both water-safety mandate and religious modesty, escalating only when cheaper options fail.
Respectful of family's sincere beliefs and of school/class; inclusive framing, consent, and diversity-focused class sheet.
Defers to head-teacher and cantonal office but cites no case law (BGE 135 I 79) or verifiable sources.

position: Common-rule-first with accommodations (modest attire first, exemption last resort)
summary: A thorough, tiered proposal that keeps swimming compulsory while accommodating religious modesty, deferring final decisions to school and cantonal authorities.
